short_citation: Kim Son and Jeong; Large-scale quantitative analysis of painting arts
main_evidence: Ranks RGB color use, box-counts occupied RGB gamut, and measures grayscale brightness roughness and weighted entropy across 8798 Web Gallery of Art paintings
central_limit: One web catalog and period-level comparisons confound painter content medium chronology capture and present-day material condition
protocol_consequence: Implement RCD box-count HDC roughness and weighted-entropy formulas only as source-faithful historical baselines; qualify color scale and source variants separately

short_citation: Lee et al.; Chromatic-distance heterogeneity in paintings
main_evidence: Tests local chromatic-distance distributions and scale normalization across painting groups
central_limit: Group and reproduction confounds remain; normalized shape can discard magnitude
protocol_consequence: Retain raw response curves and normalized distributions with source and scale gates

short_citation: Seo et al.; Information-theoretic analysis of color interaction in paintings
main_evidence: Partitions three paintings into quasi-homogeneous color blocks and compares multiscale color interaction with eight harmonic templates
central_limit: Three examples and template-dependent harmony interpretation provide no painter specificity or source robustness
protocol_consequence: Do not treat harmony-template agreement as a painter feature; retain multiscale partition logic only as an exploratory color-composition diagnostic

short_citation: Sigaki Perc and Ribeiro; History of art through entropy and complexity
main_evidence: Applies permutation entropy and statistical complexity to more than one hundred thousand paintings
central_limit: Movement and chronology trends may reflect source resolution codec and corpus composition
protocol_consequence: Treat entropy and complexity as descriptive summaries with source and scale sensitivity

short_citation: Lee et al.; Information-theoretic landscape composition
main_evidence: Defines information-theoretic landscape composition statistics and historical comparisons
central_limit: Genre-specific corpus and surrogate-image domain limit painter claims
protocol_consequence: Use as content-specific composition evidence and require cross-content transfer

short_citation: Kim Lee and Lee; Diversity and stylization of contemporary user-generated visual arts
main_evidence: Relates ordinal-pattern complexity and entropy to ResNet- and SIFT-based within-group diversity for 149780 DeviantArt and Behance images from 2010 to 2020
central_limit: Platform categories time export pipelines and user-generated media are entangled; the study does not validate historical-painter distributions
protocol_consequence: Use only as exploratory platform-level evidence linking local-order coordinates to representation diversity, not as Western-painting or painter-feature qualification

short_citation: Tarozo et al.; Two-by-two ordinal patterns in art paintings
main_evidence: Defines a tie-aware 75-state two-by-two ordinal distribution and 11 smoothness groups and evaluates style and temporal patterns in 137364 WikiArt paintings
central_limit: Single-pixel scale exact ties heterogeneous JPEG reproduction and random style splits remain source resolution and label dependent
protocol_consequence: Retain the full 75-state distribution and 11 group rates with explicit tie scale perturbation source and held-work checks before scalar summaries

short_citation: Papia et al.; Complexity analysis of artworks
main_evidence: Evaluates nonlinear complexity statistics on digitized art
central_limit: Limited construct validation and reproduction controls
protocol_consequence: Retain as sensitivity family not a universal aesthetic measure

short_citation: Silva et al.; Image complexity and painter classification
main_evidence: Uses image descriptors and learning to discriminate art groups
central_limit: Classification does not separate content source and painter practice
protocol_consequence: Use held-work and nuisance-qualified classification only

short_citation: Yang et al.; Entropy measures for painting analysis
main_evidence: Compares entropy-derived descriptors across art-image groups
central_limit: Downloaded-image processing and label overlap constrain inference
protocol_consequence: Require multiscale response curves and work-level inference

short_citation: Nascimento et al.; The colors of paintings and viewers' preferences
main_evidence: Has 50 naive observers rotate the three-dimensional color gamut of 10 paintings and finds pooled preferred orientations close to the originals
central_limit: Ten works and aesthetic preference do not establish painter specificity or colorimetric fidelity of digital reproductions
protocol_consequence: Use gamut orientation and covariance as human color-organization hypotheses under a declared color workflow, not as painter identity or physical-color truth

short_citation: Nakauchi et al.; Color distributions and perception of paintings
main_evidence: Links manipulation of color statistics to perceptual responses
central_limit: Stimulus and observer domain do not establish painter specificity
protocol_consequence: Use controlled color transformations in human and perturbation validation

short_citation: Nakauchi and Tamura; Colour statistics and composition preferences in art paintings
main_evidence: Relates preference judgments from 31353 participants viewing original and hue-rotated versions of 1200 paintings to image color statistics and tests a matching-to-nature account
central_limit: Aesthetic preference is not painterly manner; web-presented stimuli and regressions over image statistics do not establish capture stability or painter specificity
protocol_consequence: Use original-versus-hue-rotation preference only as human color-organization evidence and keep it separate from reproduction invariance and painter-feature claims

short_citation: Graham and Field; Statistical regularities of art-image spectra
main_evidence: Compares spatial-frequency statistics of artworks and natural scenes
central_limit: Spectrum depends on crop borders resolution and luminance mapping
protocol_consequence: Retain octave-band power slope fit diagnostics and anisotropy

short_citation: Graham and Field; Variations in intensity statistics for art
main_evidence: Studies intensity-distribution regularities and departures in artworks
central_limit: Convenience corpus and surrogate preprocessing limit population claims
protocol_consequence: Use as rationale for explicit luminance-distribution controls

short_citation: Lyu Rockmore and Farid; Digital analysis of artistic images
main_evidence: Uses multiscale wavelet statistics for digital art authentication-style discrimination
central_limit: Tiny corpus and attribution framing do not validate general painter distributions
protocol_consequence: Retain fixed wavelet-energy coordinates and reject authentication language

short_citation: Hughes Graham and Rockmore; Sparse coding analysis of Bruegel drawings
main_evidence: Learns overcomplete sparse bases from authentic Bruegel drawing patches and uses response kurtosis to discriminate secure works from imitations against wavelet and curvelet baselines
central_limit: Small specialist drawing corpus patch resampling and learned bases do not establish an independent work-level painter distribution
protocol_consequence: If retained use as a learned sparse-coding diagnostic with frozen patch scale training split and random initialization, not as a wavelet feature

short_citation: Johnson et al.; Image processing for Van Gogh painting investigation
main_evidence: Combines image processing with art-historical and conservation evidence
central_limit: Painter-specific case study and technical images do not generalize to catalog RGB
protocol_consequence: Use to define multimodal validation boundary and avoid RGB brushwork claims

short_citation: Li et al.; Rhythmic brushstroke analysis for painter identification
main_evidence: Defines stroke-scale image descriptors and painter classification
central_limit: Digitization and content matching are limited; classifier signal is not authorship proof
protocol_consequence: Use as candidate local-orientation evidence with source and scale gates

short_citation: Lamberti Sanna and Paravati; Unsupervised extraction of visible brushstrokes from van Gogh works
main_evidence: Uses iterative grayscale region growing and shape constraints to extract brushstroke orientation length and width from normalized van Gogh patches and compares results with human and prior-algorithm judgments
central_limit: Single-painter patch data parameter calibration and resolution normalization limit transfer; extracted image regions are not literal physical strokes without scale evidence
protocol_consequence: Retain only as a visible-region extraction candidate under physical-scale resolution and human-annotation gates; do not describe it as wavelet analysis

short_citation: Abry et al.; Wavelet leaders and multifractal analysis
main_evidence: Provides rigorous multiscale and multifractal estimation methodology
central_limit: Requires adequate scaling ranges and is not art-specific construct evidence
protocol_consequence: Keep multifractal estimates secondary with fit-range diagnostics

short_citation: Wu et al.; Painting analysis using wavelets and probabilistic topic models
main_evidence: Combines dual-tree complex wavelets hidden Markov trees and a topic model on Giotto altarpiece panels
central_limit: Single case corpus and patch-derived observations do not establish painter-level generality
protocol_consequence: Retain wavelet-topic structure as case evidence and require source-disjoint physical-work validation

short_citation: Qi Taeb and Hughes; Visual stylometry using multiscale statistics
main_evidence: Defines stylometric features for art-image classification
central_limit: Classification and small corpus do not prove invariant painter practice
protocol_consequence: Require held physical works and hard-neighbor transfer

short_citation: Ji et al.; Identifying the painter's hand through surface topography
main_evidence: Uses controlled optical surface topography to distinguish painter-associated handling
central_limit: Small controlled experiment and specialized height data do not transfer to ordinary RGB
protocol_consequence: Use as a comparator for literal painter-hand evidence and keep RGB claims at image-structure level

short_citation: Bigerelle et al.; Surface texture analysis of paintings
main_evidence: Measures physical surface texture with metrological methods
central_limit: Requires surface or topographic acquisition absent from catalog RGB
protocol_consequence: Do not infer impasto or surface topography from ordinary image texture

short_citation: Koch Denzler and Redies; Fourier power characteristics and isotropy in visual art
main_evidence: Measures windowed two-dimensional Fourier power-spectrum slope and orientation anisotropy across artworks cartoons comics manga and photograph categories
central_limit: Large group overlap and category/content effects remain; the authors state that near-1/f-squared spectra and low anisotropy are neither necessary nor sufficient for aesthetic quality
protocol_consequence: Retain Fourier slope curvature band-power and anisotropy profiles with window scale content and source controls

short_citation: Braun et al.; PHOG properties of advertisements artworks and architecture
main_evidence: Compares PHOG-derived gradient complexity self-similarity and anisotropy across print advertisements visual artworks and architectural images
central_limit: Category-level results depend on standardized image size PHOG pyramid depth content and source and do not isolate painter
protocol_consequence: Retain transparent multiscale gradient profiles with fixed pyramid settings and require content source and reproduction tests

short_citation: Redies et al.; Edge orientation in visual art
main_evidence: Defines edge-orientation organization and compares artworks with other images
central_limit: Composition and subject can drive orientation structure
protocol_consequence: Use threshold curves and content-matched leave-out validation

short_citation: Redies and Brachmann; Statistical image properties in traditional bad and abstract art
main_evidence: Evaluates PHOG-like self-similarity and complexity measures
central_limit: Image categories and framing remain competing explanations
protocol_consequence: Use multiscale self-similarity as a secondary coordinate

short_citation: Redies and Gross; Frames and statistical image properties in museums
main_evidence: Finds frame-associated changes in PHOG complexity self-similarity and anisotropy and no significant aggregate reproduction-group differences for 27 and 31 matched paintings after standardizing to 100000 pixels
central_limit: Null group tests are not equivalence or work-level repeatability estimates; technical ancestry was unavailable and standardization was chosen partly to suppress scan halftone structure
protocol_consequence: Include frame and crop perturbations and run paired same-work equivalence and repeatability tests for every feature instead of inferring reproduction invariance

short_citation: Fuchs et al.; Saliency and composition in paintings
main_evidence: Uses computational saliency to analyze pictorial composition
central_limit: Saliency model and subject content are intertwined
protocol_consequence: Keep saliency separate and validate against content-matched human tasks

short_citation: Le Meur et al.; Visual attention and paintings
main_evidence: Compares saliency or gaze behavior in artworks
central_limit: Observer task and content dominate transfer to painter identity
protocol_consequence: Use as human-composition evidence not a painter ground truth

short_citation: Amirshahi et al.; Rule of thirds in visual art
main_evidence: Empirically evaluates rule-of-thirds claims using image statistics
central_limit: Weak or context-dependent regularity; crop and subject matter matter
protocol_consequence: Reject universal composition rule and retain transparent spatial coordinates

short_citation: McManus et al.; Visual balance in art
main_evidence: Tests computational and human measures of balance
central_limit: Balance is task and stimulus dependent
protocol_consequence: Use balance only with explicit human criterion task

short_citation: Mather; Visual image statistics and aesthetic composition
main_evidence: Synthesizes and tests image-statistical composition hypotheses
central_limit: Not painter-specific and partly theoretical
protocol_consequence: Use to define candidate coordinates and claim limits

short_citation: Swartz et al.; Image statistics and art perception
main_evidence: Recent behavioral link between image statistics and art judgments
central_limit: Observer and stimulus sample limit universality
protocol_consequence: Require held-work human predictive validation

short_citation: Taylor Micolich and Jonas; Fractal analysis of Pollock
main_evidence: Introduces fractal analysis of Pollock drip paintings
central_limit: Authentication and scaling claims are sensitive to method and image domain
protocol_consequence: Do not treat fractal dimension as quality or authenticity

short_citation: Taylor et al.; Fractal analysis for Pollock discrimination
main_evidence: Extends box-counting or fractal discrimination claims
central_limit: Method has contested specificity and scaling ranges
protocol_consequence: Use only as falsification example with preregistered fit ranges

short_citation: Jones-Smith and Mathur; Fractal analysis critique
main_evidence: Shows that simple drawings can satisfy proposed Pollock fractal criteria
central_limit: Directly falsifies uniqueness of a scalar fractal signature
protocol_consequence: Prohibit fractal-authenticity inference

short_citation: Mureika et al.; Multifractal structure in Pollock paintings
main_evidence: Explores multifractal properties of drip paintings
central_limit: Scaling and corpus specificity remain contested
protocol_consequence: Keep multifractal estimates exploratory only

short_citation: Montagner et al.; Statistics of colors in paintings and natural scenes
main_evidence: Compares CIELAB gamut geometry and color-occurrence power laws in hyperspectral data from 44 abstract or figurative paintings and 50 natural scenes
central_limit: Small mixed painting set and hyperspectral acquisition do not establish painter specificity or recoverability from ordinary museum RGB
protocol_consequence: Use as a hyperspectral modality boundary and a hypothesis source for RGB-specific gamut and color-frequency coordinates, not as surface-feature evidence

short_citation: Kim Lee You and Yun; Context-aware multimodal AI and art evolution
main_evidence: Defines 16384D SD2 VAE A-vectors and 1024D CLIP C-vectors for 72447 paintings
central_limit: Forced-square stochastic A path incomplete code mixed preprocessing source bias and pretraining overlap
protocol_consequence: Replicate by exact name only; never use A or C alone as the painter feature

short_citation: Mao Cheung and She; DeepArt and ART500K
main_evidence: Introduces ART500K and joint content-style representation learning
central_limit: Aggregated provenance duplicates labels and joint supervision confound form and context
protocol_consequence: Audit work identity source and label provenance before corpus reuse

short_citation: Gatys Ecker and Bethge; Neural style transfer
main_evidence: Uses VGG feature correlations as exemplar texture-style statistics
central_limit: Stationary Gram correlations discard layout and lack painter-distribution validation
protocol_consequence: Use only as a formal-texture baseline

short_citation: Li et al.; Demystifying neural style transfer
main_evidence: Shows Gram matching is an MMD with a second-order polynomial kernel
central_limit: Mathematical equivalence does not establish painter construct validity
protocol_consequence: Name the encoder and kernel explicitly

short_citation: Karayev et al.; Recognizing image style
main_evidence: Shows object-trained deep features predict photographic and painting style labels
central_limit: Content and scene cues can drive style classification
protocol_consequence: Treat classification as shortcut-sensitive signal not construct proof

short_citation: Saleh and Elgammal; Large-scale fine-art classification
main_evidence: Learns artist genre and style classification or retrieval on fine art
central_limit: WikiArt content chronology and acquisition are entangled
protocol_consequence: Use as attribution baseline under work and source-disjoint splits

short_citation: Elgammal et al.; Shape of art history in the eyes of the machine
main_evidence: Uses CNN style classification and temporal manifolds over about 67000 paintings
central_limit: Latent historical axes may encode subject chronology and source
protocol_consequence: Use for hypotheses not calibrated measurement

short_citation: Cetinic Lipic and Grgic; Fine-tuning CNNs for fine-art classification
main_evidence: Compares object scene and sentiment initialization across art tasks
central_limit: Upstream pretraining changes what the representation measures
protocol_consequence: Report evaluator-family sensitivity

short_citation: Strezoski and Worring; OmniArt benchmark
main_evidence: Aggregates over two million art records and many metadata tasks
central_limit: Source imbalance duplicates and ontology conflicts
protocol_consequence: Use only after work-level deduplication and provenance audit

short_citation: Garcia and Vogiatzis; SemArt multimodal retrieval
main_evidence: Pairs WGA paintings with catalogue descriptions for semantic retrieval
central_limit: Text can reveal painter date subject and context directly
protocol_consequence: Keep contextual validation separate from formal painter coordinates

short_citation: Gairola Shah and Narayanan; Unsupervised image style embeddings
main_evidence: Learns compact embeddings from Gram-derived pseudo-style triplets
central_limit: Supervision distills Gram assumptions rather than independently validating style
protocol_consequence: Test only after content and source qualification

short_citation: Ruta et al.; ALADIN fine-grained style similarity
main_evidence: Uses all-layer AdaIN statistics and weak style groups on BAM-FG
central_limit: Modern digital-art groups leak creator content and platform domain
protocol_consequence: Require historical-painting and source/content transfer

short_citation: Ruta et al.; StyleBabel
main_evidence: Builds expert-led style taxonomy and captions for about 135000 digital artworks
central_limit: Modern digital and English-language domain
protocol_consequence: Adapt vocabulary for separate human attribute tasks

short_citation: Dumoulin Shlens and Kudlur; Learned representation for artistic style
main_evidence: Conditional normalization parameters control multiple exemplar styles
central_limit: Generation control lacks independent painter-similarity validation
protocol_consequence: Do not use generator parameters as painter measurements

short_citation: Kotovenko et al.; Content-style disentanglement
main_evidence: Uses triplet and fixpoint losses with painter classifiers and human tests
central_limit: Ten-painter scope and deception tasks do not establish oeuvre coverage
protocol_consequence: Adopt content-matched patches and separate human controls

short_citation: Wu Nakashima and Garcia; GOYA
main_evidence: Learns CLIP transforms from synthetic content-style pairs and tests WikiArt
central_limit: Diffusion and CLIP priors define the separation; labels imperfect
protocol_consequence: Use only as evaluator-family sensitivity

short_citation: Liao et al.; ArtBench
main_evidence: Provides 60000 balanced artworks in ten movement classes
central_limit: Coarse movement labels and WikiArt provenance are not painter ground truth
protocol_consequence: Use for coarse stress tests only

short_citation: Achlioptas et al.; ArtEmis
main_evidence: Collects about 455000 emotion explanations over about 80000 artworks
central_limit: Affect and content are not painterly-form criteria
protocol_consequence: Use to probe contextual and affective leakage

short_citation: Mohammad and Kiritchenko; WikiArt Emotions
main_evidence: Collects 41985 responses on 4105 artworks across emotion categories
central_limit: Crowd affect labels are population and context specific
protocol_consequence: Treat disagreement as part of criterion uncertainty

short_citation: Mohamed et al.; ArtELingo
main_evidence: Provides multilingual culturally diverse emotion annotations over art
central_limit: Affective response varies by language and culture
protocol_consequence: Do not universalize web-trained contextual scores

short_citation: Somepalli et al.; Contrastive Style Descriptors
main_evidence: Trains CLIP backbones on 511921 caption-tagged images and evaluates artist retrieval
central_limit: Artist tags supervise training; random WikiArt splits and released-weight discrepancy remain
protocol_consequence: Fail closed until checkpoint reconciliation and local source content coverage gates

short_citation: Frochte; Diagnosing raw CSD cosine
main_evidence: Finds negative same-versus-nearest-other painter gaps and candidate-pool effects
central_limit: Preprint; small curated set and inaccurate description of original CSD training
protocol_consequence: Prohibit raw cosine as calibrated painter fidelity

short_citation: Moayeri et al.; ArtSavant and artistic imitation
main_evidence: Uses set-level CLIP classifiers and interpretable tags for 372 painters
central_limit: Recognition may exploit content source period and pretraining exposure
protocol_consequence: Adopt one-versus-many set voting and abstention but reject recognizability as style proof

short_citation: Su et al.; Identifying prompted artist names
main_evidence: Benchmarks 1.95 million generated images across 110 painters and generators
central_limit: Measures prompted-name recovery with strong generator-domain dependence
protocol_consequence: Use as prompt-system audit not real-oeuvre fidelity

short_citation: Song Liu and Shou; DiffSim
main_evidence: Uses aligned diffusion attention features across visual similarity benchmarks
central_limit: Diffusion-model coupling and mixed content/background signal
protocol_consequence: Use as evaluator-family sensitivity only

short_citation: Wright and Ommer; ArtFID
main_evidence: Combines LPIPS with FID in an art-trained encoder and validates method ranks with human pairs
central_limit: Aggregate style-transfer rank is not painter target fit or coverage; FID needs large samples
protocol_consequence: Never use ArtFID alone for painter fidelity

short_citation: Zhang et al.; LPIPS
main_evidence: Calibrates deep feature distance on hundreds of thousands of distortion judgments
central_limit: Full-reference distortion similarity is not unpaired painter style
protocol_consequence: Use for same-work reproduction and content-preservation controls

short_citation: Ding et al.; DISTS
main_evidence: Combines deep structure and texture statistics for image-quality assessment
central_limit: Full-reference image quality domain differs from painter distribution
protocol_consequence: Use in reproduction perturbation qualification

short_citation: Fu et al.; DreamSim
main_evidence: Learns from 477964 human judgments on synthetic visual-similarity triplets
central_limit: Synthetic generator bias and holistic semantic sensitivity
protocol_consequence: Use as separate overall-appearance comparator

short_citation: Hessel et al.; CLIPScore
main_evidence: Validates CLIP image-text alignment against caption-quality judgments
central_limit: Measures semantics and prompt alignment rather than painterly form
protocol_consequence: Keep prompt coherence outside painter score

short_citation: Pizzi et al.; SSCD copy detection
main_evidence: Self-supervised descriptor validated for image-copy detection
central_limit: Thresholds are domain-specific and copy similarity is not style
protocol_consequence: Use only for exact and near-copy audit with local calibration

short_citation: Somepalli et al.; Diffusion art or digital forgery
main_evidence: Searches diffusion samples for training-data replication
central_limit: Search covers only a subset of the training universe and cannot estimate full prevalence
protocol_consequence: Separate copying from painter similarity

short_citation: Carlini et al.; Extracting training data from diffusion models
main_evidence: Extracts more than one thousand training examples via generate-and-filter attacks
central_limit: Shows possibility rather than normal artist-prompt prevalence
protocol_consequence: Audit extraction risk separately from fidelity

short_citation: Somepalli et al.; Understanding and mitigating copying
main_evidence: Shows text conditioning and caption structure affect diffusion copying
central_limit: Copying behavior depends on model and prompt distribution
protocol_consequence: Include prompt-level memorization checks

short_citation: Wen et al.; Detecting explaining and mitigating memorization
main_evidence: Uses first-step text-conditioned prediction magnitude to flag memorization-prone prompts
central_limit: Model-specific diagnostic not a painter feature
protocol_consequence: Record token-level risk separately

short_citation: Chen et al.; Local memorization via Bright Ending Attention
main_evidence: Detects and localizes memorized image patches in diffusion outputs
central_limit: Recent model-specific method and not a style measure
protocol_consequence: Audit local copied motifs and signatures

short_citation: Wang et al.; Evaluating data attribution for text-to-image models
main_evidence: Builds controlled attribution evaluation by customization
central_limit: Influence by construction does not prove opaque-base training inclusion
protocol_consequence: Use only as attribution-method validation

short_citation: ISO 19264-1; Photography archiving systems image-quality analysis
main_evidence: Specifies methods to analyze imaging-system quality for cultural heritage
central_limit: Standard compliance needs capture targets and cannot be inferred for downloaded files
protocol_consequence: Use to design capture metadata and reproduction qualification

short_citation: FADGI Technical Guidelines for Digitizing Cultural Heritage Materials
main_evidence: Defines preservation-imaging performance levels and testing practices
central_limit: A guideline does not calibrate legacy web derivatives
protocol_consequence: Record targets tone response resolution color and sharpening provenance

short_citation: Metamorfoze Preservation Imaging Guidelines
main_evidence: Defines preservation reproduction tolerances and workflow controls
central_limit: Primarily institutional capture guidance rather than painter-feature validation
protocol_consequence: Use to specify same-work independent-capture panel

short_citation: Korytkowski and Olejnik-Krugly; Precise capture of colors in cultural heritage digitization
main_evidence: Tests a controlled color-target workflow for precise cultural-heritage capture
central_limit: Specific devices targets and collections limit generality
protocol_consequence: Require ICC-aware processing and report residual color error

short_citation: Olejnik-Krugly and Korytkowski; Precise color capture using custom color targets
main_evidence: Evaluates custom-target calibrated color capture
central_limit: Controlled setup differs from heterogeneous online assets
protocol_consequence: Separate profiled and assumed-sRGB strata

short_citation: Kirchner et al.; Exploring the limits of color accuracy in technical photography
main_evidence: Empirically evaluates achievable technical-photography color accuracy and its conditions
central_limit: Results depend on target workflow and material surface
protocol_consequence: Use color-error evidence to set perturbation ranges and claim limits

short_citation: Berns; Digital color reproduction and cultural heritage review
main_evidence: Establishes colorimetric reproduction principles and limitations for artwork imaging
central_limit: Review-level and technology-specific details require current validation
protocol_consequence: Supports observation model and physical-versus-digital distinction

short_citation: MacDonald et al.; Colour image reproduction for museums
main_evidence: Early empirical museum color-reproduction workflow evidence
central_limit: Legacy devices and small case domain
protocol_consequence: Use as historical evidence that source workflow matters

short_citation: Amano Linhares and Nascimento; Color constancy of color reproductions in art paintings
main_evidence: Tests perceptual color constancy for originals and reproductions rendered under controlled illuminants
central_limit: Five paintings selected regions and controlled viewing do not establish colorimetric equivalence
protocol_consequence: Do not treat observer tolerance as proof that painter color coordinates are reproduction-stable

short_citation: Sharma Wu and Dalal; CIEDE2000 implementation notes
main_evidence: Provides equations and reference pairs for CIEDE2000
central_limit: Perceptual color difference is not a painter construct and assumes valid color coordinates
protocol_consequence: Use verified fixtures for color-distance sensitivity branch

short_citation: Szucs and Sik-Lanyi; Color rendering of Sistine Chapel reproductions
main_evidence: Compares color patches in web and print reproductions with reference or in-situ measurements
central_limit: Four frescoes and patch comparisons do not characterize every spatial feature
protocol_consequence: Record browser codec profile print and display stages as measurement provenance

short_citation: Ribes et al.; Multispectral imaging for cultural heritage
main_evidence: Demonstrates multispectral artwork acquisition and reconstruction
central_limit: Requires modalities absent from online RGB
protocol_consequence: Use to define out-of-scope physical and spectral claims

short_citation: Liang; Advances in multispectral and hyperspectral imaging for archaeology and art conservation
main_evidence: Reviews and demonstrates spectral imaging applications in heritage science
central_limit: Secondary and specialized modality evidence
protocol_consequence: Require new protocol before spectral or underdrawing claims

short_citation: Pillay et al.; Technical imaging of cultural heritage
main_evidence: Shows calibrated technical-imaging applications to artworks
central_limit: Not recoverable from ordinary RGB and case specific
protocol_consequence: Keep technical material evidence separate

short_citation: Zhao et al.; Perception of artistic style
main_evidence: Behavioral experiments test how observers categorize or compare visual style
central_limit: Task stimuli and observer population define the construct
protocol_consequence: Use pair or triplet tasks and report expertise or population scope

short_citation: Boger and Firestone; Human recognition of artistic style
main_evidence: Large behavioral study of style recognition and generalization
central_limit: Recognition can include learned attribution and content cues
protocol_consequence: Cross same-painter cross-content with content-matched cross-painter trials

short_citation: Kovashka and Lease; Human and machine detection of stylistic similarity in art
main_evidence: Collects thousands of judgments over paintings and compares computational filters with people
central_limit: Limited paintings and participant knowledge; repeated judgments and works are dependent
protocol_consequence: Use held-work triplets and crossed rater-work inference

short_citation: Hess and Wallsten; Adult age differences in perception and learning of artistic style categories
main_evidence: Tests how adult age relates to learning and perceiving artistic style categories
central_limit: Age and category-learning task do not provide a comparative-judgment scaling method
protocol_consequence: Model rater population learning and familiarity instead of assuming invariant style perception

short_citation: Bruns et al.; Deep network representation of art-style similarity judgments
main_evidence: Compares human art-style similarity judgments with deep-network representations
central_limit: Conference abstract with limited method detail; does not test expertise strata
protocol_consequence: Use only as a lead for human-model convergence and do not infer expertise effects

short_citation: Cronbach and Meehl; Construct validity in psychological tests
main_evidence: Defines construct validity as accumulated nomological evidence
central_limit: Foundational theory not a direct painter-feature validation
protocol_consequence: Require multiple convergent and discriminant tests

short_citation: Campbell and Fiske; Convergent and discriminant validation
main_evidence: Introduces multitrait-multimethod logic
central_limit: Classical framework needs adaptation to modern crossed designs
protocol_consequence: Cross feature families and human task constructs

short_citation: Messick; Validity of psychological assessment
main_evidence: Frames validity as evidence supporting score interpretation and use
central_limit: Conceptual rather than an executable art method
protocol_consequence: Tie each coordinate to an explicit claim ceiling

short_citation: Flake Pek and Hehman; Construct validation in social research
main_evidence: Documents construct-measure mismatch and proposes transparent validation
central_limit: Social-science examples not art-specific
protocol_consequence: Publish construct and non-construct statement for every coordinate

short_citation: Reymond et al.; Aesthetic evaluation of digitally reproduced art images
main_evidence: Crosses saturation viewing duration and art experience for digitally reproduced paintings
central_limit: Liking and emotion over sixteen works do not measure painter specificity; device conditions vary
protocol_consequence: Predefine expertise and viewing strata and keep liking separate from painter-manner judgments

short_citation: Locher Smith and Smith; Original paintings versus slide and computer reproductions
main_evidence: Compares viewer responses to nine works as originals slides and computer images
central_limit: Small legacy-display study; perceptual accommodation is not metric invariance
protocol_consequence: Treat reproduction format as an experimental facet and test equivalence rather than assume it

short_citation: Iigaya et al.; Predicting aesthetic preference from low- and high-level visual features
main_evidence: Shows low- and high-level image variables jointly predict individual art preference
central_limit: Preference is not painterly manner and model selection shares stimulus structure
protocol_consequence: Use liking and generic aesthetic quality as discriminant outcomes

short_citation: Yeh et al.; Improving style transfer with calibrated metrics
main_evidence: Calibrates separate style-transfer effectiveness and coherence measures against human pairs
central_limit: Method-level neural style transfer with one style reference does not estimate a painter distribution
protocol_consequence: Separate resemblance and content preservation and sample many real reference works

short_citation: Meredith; Measurement invariance factor analysis and factorial invariance
main_evidence: Formalizes invariance conditions required before comparing latent scores across groups
central_limit: Factor-model conditions require adaptation for forced choices and art judgments
protocol_consequence: Test group and display invariance or report population-specific painter relations

short_citation: Specker et al.; Vienna Art Interest and Art Knowledge Questionnaire
main_evidence: Validates separate measures of art interest and art knowledge
central_limit: General art knowledge is not painter-specific attribution expertise
protocol_consequence: Record formal role training knowledge interest and painter familiarity separately

short_citation: Bradley and Terry; Rank analysis by paired comparisons
